purpose: Baseline defect reproduction; not release acceptance

findings.explanation: Linear feature styling uses parseFloat and discards the explicit feet unit.
The left sidewalk is placed south of an eastbound way.
Route elevation samples the road centerline before shifting sideways. This synthetic slope demonstrates the mismatch, not the slope of a real site.
Per-side separate mapping is ignored by pedestrian inference, creating additional inferred sidewalks.
Both enter the same paved presentation category. This is semantic flattening, not proof that the original provider omitted their geometry.
